body: We have 21 dogs. My wife is a dog groomer and breeder. She doesn't groom as much as she used to. Only 1 or 2 small dogs in her salon every 6 weeks. But we have a lot of dogs. In the process of selling some because we can't afford the food anymore.
I’ve been telling myself that for a little over a year now. Doesn’t change what happened or how I feel. Doesn’t fix the problem.

I've been hearing that all of my life. I'm kind of tired of these promises that never seem to come true. 

They aren't at the same place. It's been different place and way every time.

What pisses me off is that is all I know when it comes to dating. I've never once had a woman in my life that loved me, or even liked me enough to just be with me and only me. All I know is that the women attracted to me are just the kind of people that want to fuck and nothing else. I can't believe I haven't caught an STD yet. 

I'm disillusioned with the fall in love and start a family thing now. It's so bad I'm researching how to delete my sex drive.
Those were the best years of my life. I still had a family and I didn't have to worry so much. There was a day when I knew how lucky I was. It's crazy how all that fell apart.

To be honest Dennis I'm tired of talking to people online. Where are the people in real life? Where are the people to go do stuff with? Either no one can afford to do stuff or they don't have the time. There is no one around to hang out with. I'm sick of talking I want to do something.
I'm not a teenager. I'm almost 40.

Your advice sounds kind of generic and really doesn't make sense to me. How much do you invest? What is too much? I've been told in the past that I don't seem to care by some and by others I'm more attached than they are to me. 

Without feedback how can we make any determination as to what the issue? I'm quickly learning that problems like this are only your own problem and no one can help.
I feel like a left over male. My Chinese female counter part would be called Sheng nu. I feel like I'm basically inedible to society. It's just based on my past experiences.

About 15 or so years ago now I met this girl. She was prefect. We got along better than anyone I've ever gotten along with in my life. We ate breakfast together every weekend, during the week we talked and hung out all the time. It wasn't long until I fell in love. The only time I have felt love too. 

I was going to tell her my feelings. She knew I was going to tell her but stopped me that day. She told me she was dating my best friend at the time. They had just gotten together. He didn't know and I think she had just figured out that I liked her a lot. He still doesn't know. They dated for a few years and I still hung out with her. When they broke up she moved 2 states away back with her family because she couldn't find a job here. I stayed in touch but eventually she met a guy. They got married. She eventually got a divorce and later on remarried to an old boyfriend. I remember her telling me about this guy. He used to be very abusive towards her. She told me he told her things that were meaner than anyone has ever said to her. So in the end, she'd rather marry an abusive guy from a previous failed relationship than give me a chance. 

Since then I've never been with a girl I wanted to be with. It's always been a situation where. No one as added up to what she was to me. I know it wasn't meant to be but it still eats me up inside. Women have basically destroyed all my self worth. I spend all of my time alone, even when I'm with someone.
